text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"organized introduction, body paragraphs, conclusion","quality":"text organization","description":"The essay has a clear overall structure that guides the reader through its points in a deliberate order."},{"evidence":"“To begin with,” “Secondly,” “Lastly,” “In conclusion”","quality":"transitional control","description":"It uses signposting and transitions to connect ideas and make the progression of the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"“wouldn't feel rushed,” “teachers would have more time,” “school will be out earlier”","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops each point with explanation and support rather than only stating opinions."},{"evidence":"“for their entire life,” “beneficial to both the student and the teacher”","quality":"sentence fluency","description":"Its sentences generally read smoothly and are combined in a more controlled, coherent way."},{"evidence":"“which are all very helpful for them”","quality":"word choice","description":"It uses more precise and academic vocabulary choices that fit persuasive writing."},{"evidence":"“teacher will have more time to teach and using new ways”","quality":"grammar control","description":"It makes fewer and less disruptive grammar and agreement errors overall than the other essay."}]}
